meta.name: Bicchoo Ka Khel 1080p
meta.description: What happens when a young student loses his father to a cover-up? Can he find it in himself to forget the past and move on, or is revenge the only thing that can give him some peace of mind?

videos.title: Duniya Gol Hai, Har Paap Ka Double Role Hai
Asteen Ka Saanp
videos.overview: Babu gets arrested for Munna Singh's murder. But the lack of evidence works in his favour, and he gets bail. However, fate works in mysterious ways.

videos.title: Kisi ki chinta, kisi ka chutkula
videos.overview: Akhil devises an escape plan for Babu with Goli Yadav's help. Anil Chaubey divulges his modus operandi, and Protima visits Babu in jail. Later, Babu commits suicide, and Akhil vows to avenge him.

videos.title: Paapi Devta
videos.overview: After Akhil finds an important clue in Babu's suicide case, he investigates the suspects and confronts Anil Chaubey with substantial proof.

videos.title: Saanp seedhi ka khel
videos.overview: Rashmi is proven to be the prime suspect in Anil Chaubey's murder. Akhil doubts that Rajveer and Goldy are involved in Munna Singh's murder. A decrypted call between Goldy and Rajveer proves Akhil's suspicion right.

videos.title: Banaras to Beijing
videos.overview: Rashmi tells Akhil about her conversation with Anil Chaubey. To prove her innocence, Akhil starts looking for supporting evidence which unearths a few key learnings.

videos.title: Mujhse Bura koi nahi
videos.overview: Based on Akhil's evidence, court acquits Rashmi. Akhil manages to steer the investigation towards Rajveer and Goldy and hands over proof against them to Inspector Tiwari. Rashmi and Akhil get married.

videos.title: Kaid Mein Hai Bulbul
videos.overview: Tiwari informs Akhil about Rajveer lurking around his house. Rajveer kidnaps Rashmi, and Tiwari and Akhil pursue his trail to save Rashmi. Rajveer shoots himself before Akhil can find out Rashmi's whereabouts.
